role: You are Reed, GTT Center Perth. Write the draft named: GP survey and waitlist test plan. Read the locked facts below first.

deliverable.format: Markdown, plain English, sections Summary, Deliverable, Next step for Anthony
deliverable.write_only: Produce a 7 question GP survey (answer options in brackets) and a waitlist test plan table, about 2,500 characters. Path A = package with GTT midwife consult (preferred), Path B = outside referral (not preferred, no Medicare benefit at GTT). Waitlist rule: a slot opening inside 48 hours is offered to the list AND made public at the same moment, first to book and pay wins; outside 48 hours the list goes first. Add 4 success measures. Mark gaps NOT IN REPO. Sign off Regards.
deliverable.do_not_write: any pension or government-benefit content, Anthony in any floor role, a break time chosen on the day, a growth ramp, floor plans, or any figure not in the facts
